evidence.citation: Artifact: "Re-run the same case blindly with 2–3 fresh, context-free agents... Use a separate fresh judge for each artifact... Report the pass rate... After any revision, re-evaluate every golden case... and only make the guidebook claim once all cases meet their required pass-rate bar."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s added execution work is tied to reproducibility and evidentiary support before making a durable guidebook claim. Under the bar, reruns, fresh judging, pass-rate reporting, and regression re-evaluation are necessary validation controls rather than materially unnecessary work.
